text: The banshee is an Irish spirit of death. The name means the woman of the fairy people. Long ago she was a goddess of the land or of its sovereignty. When her glory faded, her role narrowed to a single task. She now warns that death draws near. She favors the old families of Ireland. Their names often begin with O or Mac. She appears as a hag or as a young woman. Red hair and white or green robes mark her as other. She wails and combs her hair with a golden comb. She warns of death from any cause. The Washer at the Ford warns only of a death in battle. A banshee can follow her own people when they travel. The banshee of the O'Gradys family went with them to Canada.

okr.objective: The banshee is an Irish death spirit, a fallen land goddess who warns certain families when death is near.
